changes: Scheduled observations may continue only capacity-denied unattempted endpoint ordinals using one cursor, one attempted-index set and the original global attempt/deadline budget.
No provider or quote-ingestion permit is retained during the owned50ms local wait. Direct callers and deterministic terminal query outcomes retain prompt behavior.

Typed original own-attempt and caller deadlines guard before attestation transport and after successful attestation metadata before first polling data transport. Own expiry retains provider-failure accounting; shorter scheduled closed-provider expiry retains neutral cancellation; generic and half-open cancellation retain quarantine.
Known integrity evidence and synchronous invalidation callbacks remain sticky and win if no valid alternative succeeds.
Once per continued query: fixed data/capacity diagnostic with attempt_count, unattempted_capacity_count and original_remaining_ms clamped to policy deadline.
Only test builds add two client-owned atomic phase witnesses; no production counters or global registry is added.
